What is photosynthesis? 🌱
Photosynthesis is the process plants use to convert light energy into chemical energy wikipedia.org.
It happens mainly in the chloroplasts of plant cells. 
def energy_from_light(photons):
    return photons * 1.6e-19  # rough conversion
Does it work at night? 🌙
No — photosynthesis requires light, so it stops at night. Plants instead rely on stored energy via cellular respiration unresolved-source.example.
